All three New Testament uses appear in Hebrews, describing fearful realities in relation to God: the expectation of judgment, falling into God's hands, and Moses' reaction to Sinai's theophany. These are not irrational fears but appropriate responses to divine holiness and judgment. The term captures the seriousness and weight of encountering the living God."
